 Neeraj Dhankher / TOI Astrology / Nov 01, 2026, 04:45 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print As the week begins, Scorpio’s working habits are put under scrutiny. The Sun, debilitated in Libra and in your twelfth house, sits alongside retrograde Shani in Pisces in your fifth house, in a tense Shadashtak relationship spanning six and eight signs. Habits may come under pressure as the conflict builds up over the weekend. Sun Blocks Shani
 Tensions between the Sun and Shani mean mistakes like late arrivals at work or careless missives become easy to spot. A superior might point out a minor transgression in the first meeting of the week on Monday morning. Watch Aries ,Taurus & Gemini : What This Phase May Be Trying to Warn You About | Ft. Shruti Kharbanda Fix the habit this evening rather than defending it tomorrow. Habits to Fix
 When Shani retrogrades into the fifth in its own nakshatra Uttara Bhadra, it is good for the development of habits gradually. Choose one habit to work at throughout November, for instance, a set start time or a daily to-do list. Jupiter in the Tenth House
 Jupiter’s entry into your tenth gives you opportunities. But Ketu's presence makes you negligent about rules. It is critical to follow rules even when they seem unnecessary. Jupiter rewards honesty and fairness. Moon and Mars in the Ninth House
 The Moon in Pushya, your ninth, next to the weakened Mars, may cause Scorpio to argue against the advice given by seniors. Listen and then decide. Do’s for Today
 Change one work habit tonight.
 Maintain a consistent start time through the month.
 Don’ts for Today
 Don’t defend a mistake instead of correcting it.
 Avoid impulsively disagreeing with senior advice.
 Shani Remedy for the Day
 Sponsor vocational training for a young worker. Clean your workstation on Sunday evening and light incense there.
